title: Readings outside what the radio chips can report land as missing in staging; both edges are kept
reasoning: lnk_06: "Impossible values (a corrupt RSSI, an SNR beyond what the chip can report, a value that is not a number) are treated as missing and fail the rule." Casey set the limits on PR #72: "blank values outside the range the radio chips can report. SNR: -32 to 31.75 dB. RSSI: -189 to +98 dBm". Both ranges are inclusive.
s13-m001: SNR -32.0 dB and RSSI -189 dBm, both lower edges: kept as sent.
s13-m002: SNR -32.25 dB and RSSI -190 dBm, one step below each edge: both land as missing.
s13-m003: SNR 31.75 dB and RSSI 98 dBm, both upper edges: kept as sent.
s13-m004: SNR 32.0 dB and RSSI 99 dBm, one step above each edge: both land as missing.
s13-m005: SNR 5.0 dB with RSSI 99 dBm, and s13-m006: SNR 32.0 dB with RSSI -90 dBm: only the impossible reading lands as missing; the other is kept as sent.
Every row has relay_node null, so none is a receipt (lnk_01) and none enters lnk_06's count of excluded receipts. The staging values alone are compared, by assert_lnk_06_chip_range_edges.
